title: runstate v0.2 value convention
description: Pins only the WRAPPER of the `value` topic -- the data plane. The worker emits a current value in response to a subscription, correlated by request_id and identified by `name`. The `value` payload is arbitrary but must be JSON-serializable; a sender-side json_default hook (attach()/open_channel()) coerces exotic types (numpy scalars, tensors), and an unserializable value with no hook fails fast. Only the wrapper {value, step, t} is fixed (step/t present-but-nullable; t = absolute wall-clock seconds -- the real-time axis -- or null if unstamped). Applied on top of the envelope schema.
